CustomField.description: BR-15, BR-16, PD-12. Why this rejection was permitted and the reason given: the governed context plus the acceptance policy version in force at the time. EVIDENCE, NOT POLICY - it explains a decision and defines none. Carries the policy version because the NorthstarIQ version guard establishes which definition governed a record by reading the version out of its basis; without it a rejection recorded under one policy version could be reinterpreted against a later one. Same shape as Sales_Acceptance_Basis__c, MQL_Basis__c and Routing_Reason__c, and kept separate from all of them so each decision stays independently readable.
